name: auto_apply_candidates
note: AccountFiscalPosition._get_fiscal_position (addons/account/models/partner.py:260) searches auto-applied positions by company, country, country group, VAT requirement and zip range in _order = 'sequence, id'; every active position with those criteria
source_sql: SELECT id, sequence, company_id, country_id, country_group_id, auto_apply, vat_required, zip_from, zip_to FROM account_fiscal_position WHERE active ORDER BY sequence, id

name: mappings_per_position
note: account.fiscal.position account_ids one2many (embedded as account), tax_ids many2many (accountTaxRel) and state_ids many2many (resCountryStateRel): mapping counts per position as map_account / map_tax read them; positions without mappings included with 0
source_sql: SELECT p.id AS position_id, (SELECT count(*) FROM account_fiscal_position_account a WHERE a.position_id = p.id) AS account_maps, (SELECT count(*) FROM account_fiscal_position_account_tax_rel t WHERE t.account_fiscal_position_id = p.id) AS tax_maps, (SELECT count(*) FROM account_fiscal_position_res_country_state_rel s WHERE s.account_fiscal_position_id = p.id) AS states FROM account_fiscal_position p ORDER BY p.id
